title: Induced EMF magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the induced EMF using the motional EMF formula E = Blv, obtaining 2 V.

title: Current direction in rod
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the direction of the induced current in rod ab as from b to a.

title: Circuit current calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total circuit current using Ohm's law I = E/(R+r), obtaining 0.5 A.

title: Physics principle application
description: Important: Applies Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction or the motional EMF concept correctly.

title: Right-hand rule reasoning
description: Important: Uses the right-hand rule or Lenz's law to determine current direction based on motion and field.

title: Equivalent resistance identification
description: Important: Recognizes that the total resistance in the circuit is the sum of R and r (series connection).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations and includes proper units in final answers.

title: Incorrect EMF formula
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect formula for motional EMF (e.g., E = Bv instead of E = Blv).

title: Wrong current direction
description: Pitfall: States current direction as from a to b instead of from b to a.

title: Resistance addition error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly combines resistances (e.g., uses parallel formula or omits one resistance).
